invariants: Every new or changed English string gets a Welsh draft beside it in the same change, as the service's other copy does.

increments.title: Refusals and redirects in check answers, cancel amend and delete notification are logged with the ids support searches by
increments.detail: When the plants service refuses a trader's request or redirects them away from what they asked for, support cannot tell from the logs that it happened or why. Check answers refuses Continue with a 400 when answers are incomplete; cancelling an amendment and deleting a notification each redirect when the notification is not in a state that allows it. Each of these outcome-changing branches should leave one log line that names the outcome and carries the notification reference and journey id, so a support engineer investigating a trader's report can find it.
acceptanceCriteria: When check answers refuses Continue because answers are incomplete, one log line at info level records the refusal with the notification reference and journey id.
When cancel amend redirects because the notification is not being amended, one log line records the redirect and its reason with the notification reference and journey id.
When delete notification redirects because the notification cannot be deleted, one log line records the redirect and its reason with the notification reference and journey id.
A page that renders normally logs nothing new.
